review.title: Transaction discrepancy  & App Issue
review.body:
Absolutely pathetic experience with PayZapp! I am extremely frustrated because I am not getting ANY solution to my issue.

I made a payment of ₹1,536 to Tirra/Reliance Retail Limited, but my card transaction is showing ₹2,109.83. WHY is there such a huge transaction discrepancy? I need a proper explanation for this extra amount.

What makes this even worse is that YOUR APP IS NOT WORKING PROPERLY. I am trying to raise a ticket through the Help Centre, but after selecting the transaction, it simply does not move forward. I cannot even successfully report the issue!

I have already tried every possible way — the app, Help Centre, calls and emails — and still I am getting NO proper response and NO solution. What exactly is a customer supposed to do when your own support system doesn’t work?

This is completely unacceptable. If there is a discrepancy in a card transaction, customers should be able to immediately raise a dispute and get assistance. Instead, I am wasting my time trying to get basic customer support.

PAYZAPP, PLEASE EXPLAIN WHY ₹1,536 PAYMENT IS SHOWING AS ₹2,109.83 AND FIX THIS ISSUE. Your Help Centre needs to actually WORK. I want a proper resolution, not a broken ticket system and no response.

review.title: The App is great but has few flaws
review.body:
I’ve been actively using this app for quite some time now, and it’s great because I get all the necessary features within the app related to UPI without the multiple forms of ad you get on the other apps.
But there are few flaws, and i’d like to point it out for the devs. And hope this things can be resolved through an update.
1. The app struggles with payments in low speed internet condition.
2. The scanner has trouble scanning QR code under Tubelights in bazar. Possibly due to shutter speed issue.
3. The PZ wallet is great, but the auto top-up doesn’t add upto the exact amount I configured, it just top ups that exact amount. (if configuration is ₹10, and my wallet balance is ₹2 - then the amount topped up should be ₹8. Not ₹10 again)

review.title: Two things to rectify
review.body:
I have been using PayZapp for a long time, and overall, it is a very useful and convenient app. The widgets, user interface, and reward system make it great to use. However, there are two minor issues that prevent it from being top-notch:
1. Intrusive Pop-up Ads: Every time I open the app to make a quick payment, pop-up ads for loans and credit cards appear. Having to dismiss these ads during urgent transactions is quite frustrating.
2. Transaction Speed & Weak Internet Performance: Compared to Google Pay, PayZapp takes a few seconds longer to process payments. Additionally, when the internet connection is weak, PayZapp struggles significantly to complete transactions, whereas Google Pay handles low-connectivity situations much better.
If the team can optimize payment speeds in low-network conditions and minimize intrusive pop-up ads, PayZapp would easily be the best payment app available.

review.title: Absolutely pathetic customer support and dispute resolution.
review.body:
A PayZapp wallet transaction of ₹853 on 29 June 2026 (4:24 PM) is marked as failed, yet PayZapp claims the merchant received the money. The merchant has clearly denied receiving any payment because the transaction itself shows failed. Despite repeatedly sharing the transaction details, reference number, and explaining the issue, there has been no meaningful investigation or resolution.

My hard-earned money has been stuck, and every interaction with customer support results in the same generic responses instead of an actual solution. Customers should not have to spend days chasing their own money when the transaction status itself is in dispute.

If this issue is not resolved immediately, I will be forced to escalate the matter through the Consumer Commission and highlight my experience on social media so that others are aware of how such disputes are handled.

Very disappointing experience. I expected much better from PayZapp.
